'''The Park Hotels''' is a chain of contemporary luxury five-star [[boutique hotel]]s in India belonging to the [[Apeejay Surrendra Group]], headquartered in [[Kolkata]].<ref>{{cite news |title=The Park Hotels buys second hotel in Maharashtra|url=http://www.business-standard.com/india/news/the-park-hotels-buys-second-hotel-in-maharashtra/314279/ |publisher=[[Business Standard]] |date=19 February 2008}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Business hotel chains use tech to cut costs, keep customers |url=http://www.livemint.com/2007/06/18000916/Business-hotel-chains-use-tech.html |publisher=[[Mint (newspaper)|Mint]] |date=18 June 2007}}</ref><ref name=pr>{{cite web |title=Priya Paul, the force behind Park Hotels|url=http://inhome.rediff.com/money/2005/jul/23spec3.htm |date=23 July 2005 |publisher=[[Rediff]] Money}}</ref> It comprises 30 hotels, including owned and leased, in 20 cities across four brands—The Park, The Park Collection, Zone by the Park and Zone Connect by the Park.<ref>{{cite news |title=Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels to ramp up portfolio to 4,603 keys in 5 years |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/apeejay-surrendra-park-hotels-to-ramp-up-portfolio-to-4-603-keys-in-5-years-124020501567_1.html |access-date=6 February 2024 |work=Business Standard}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:The Park Hotel Kolkata.jpg|thumb|250px|left|The Park Hotel Kolkata on [[Park Street, Kolkata|Park Street]]]]
The hotel business was started by Surrendra Paul in 1967, with the opening of the group's first hotel, The Park, a 150-room hotel on the fashionable [[Park Street, Kolkata|Park Street]] in [[Kolkata]], on 1 November; the hotel at Visakhapatnam was added in 1968, while The Park New Delhi commenced operations in 1987.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Muthalaly |first1=Shonali |title=Park here for the extraordinary: on The Park hotels turning 50 |url=https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/fashion/park-here-for-the-extraordinary-on-the-park-hotels-turning-50/article19998196.ece |access-date=6 February 2024 |work=The Hindu |date=7 November 2017 |language=en-IN}}</ref>

After the death of Surrendra Paul, his daughter [[Priya Paul]] succeeded him in 1990. Subsequently, The Park Bangalore was added in 2000, while [[The Park, Chennai|The Park Chennai]] was commissioned in 2002.<ref name=pr/><ref>{{cite news |title=The First Lady of boutique |url=http://www.expresshospitality.com/20060331/hospitalitylife03.shtml |publisher=Express Hospitality ([[Indian Express Group]]) |date=16–31 March 2006}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Innovating constantly... |url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/canvas/2003/01/18/stories/2003011800160400.htm |publisher=[[Business Line]] |date=18 January 2003}}</ref> The Park Bangalore was designed by [[Terence Conran]].<ref name=pr/><ref>{{cite news |title=Aquazone at the Park Hotel, Bangalore, India |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/health/spaspy/6513216/Aquazone-at-the-Park-Hotel-Bangalore-India.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091112084540/http://www.telegraph.co.uk/health/spaspy/6513216/Aquazone-at-the-Park-Hotel-Bangalore-India.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=12 November 2009 |newspaper=[[The Daily Telegraph|The Telegraph]] |date=9 November 2009 | location=London | access-date=25 May 2010}}</ref>

[[File:The Park Hotel.jpg|thumb|The Park Hotel in Delhi with [[Jantar Mantar, New Delhi|Jantar Mantar]] in front.]] 
The Park New Delhi took up the restoration of the 1724 built astronomical observatory, [[Jantar Mantar (Delhi)|Jantar Mantar]], in 2000, after an [[MoU]] with the [[Archaeological Survey of India]] (ASI).<ref>{{cite news |title=Reviving the magic of Jantar Mantar |url=http://www.expressindia.com/news/fe/daily/20001022/fco22005.html |publisher=[[Indian Express]] |date=22 October 2000}}</ref>

==Recognition==
The Park Kolkata was awarded the "National Tourism Award" (2003–04) for outstanding performance as the Best Boutique Hotel in the country by the Department of Tourism, [[Government of India]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Tourism award for The Park |url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/2005/01/28/stories/2005012801251700.htm |publisher=[[Business Line]] |date=28 January 2005}}</ref> The Park Kolkata won The Best Business Hotel award at Travel+ leisure India south Asia's luxury travel event 'India's Best Awards 2018' in New Delhi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/the-park-kolkata-wins-best-business-hotel-award/article25577469.ece#|title = THE Park Kolkata wins 'Best Business Hotel' award|date = 23 November 2018}}</ref> 

In 2006, ''[[Forbes]]'', listed "Atrium" in The Park Chennai, with its menu designed by Italian chef [[Antonio Carluccio]], amongst India's top 10 Most Expensive Restaurants.<ref>{{cite web |title=International Dining: India's Most Expensive Restaurants |author=Saabira Chaudhuri |url=https://www.forbes.com/2006/12/18/india-restaurants-wealth-forbeslife-food-cz_sc_1218indiaeatery.html |date=2006-12-18 |work=[[Forbes]]}}</ref> In 2010, ''[[The Independent]]'', listed The Park Hyderabad amongst its list of "100 holiday ideas for 2010".<ref>{{cite news |title=100 holiday ideas for 2010: Hotels|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/hotels/100-holiday-ideas-for-2010-hotels-1855859.html |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20220618/https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/hotels/100-holiday-ideas-for-2010-hotels-1855859.html |archive-date=18 June 2022 |url-access=subscription |url-status=live |work=[[The Independent]] |date=3 January 2010 |location=London |first=Juliet |last=Kinsman |access-date=25 May 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Celebrity Fashion Diva and Icon 2019 {{!}} The Park Hotels {{!}} Hyderabad |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4T64AQOAh54&t=95s |agency=The Hans India |ref=11}}</ref>
